name: Transport via Plants

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a Large or bigger living plant within range

summary: Link a Large or bigger plant near you to another one on the same plane.
text: Until the end of your next turn, any creature can step into the near plant and out of the far one by using 5 feet of movement. You must have seen or touched the destination plant before.
